description: This file contains a class 'BuildIdFinder' that interacts with Android build artifacts, fetches build information, and performs comparisons to find the best matching build ID. It includes methods for fetching, parsing XML, and making HTTP requests, as well as a main function for execution.

classes.name: BuildIdFinder
classes.description: A class that fetches and compares Android build artifacts to identify the most suitable build ID based on project differences.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BuildIdFinder with default or specified branch, target, and batch size, and loads local build data.

methods.name: __rating
methods.description: Fetches a build artifact, parses its XML, and compares revisions to determine difference count.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of build IDs from the server, evaluates their ratings concurrently, and recursively fetches more if needed.
